title: Connect the Group owner (@frequency) to Stripe so paid tiers can charge

source.ref: Production walk 2026-10-19, reported in the thread.

detail: Production walk of The Group (2026-10-19): the owner profile @frequency has no Stripe Connect account, so a paid Circle or event tier on the Network falls back to a free join. WAITS ON JUNE (or whoever runs @frequency): finish Stripe Connect onboarding for that owner from the Space's billing page, then confirm a paid tier shows a checkout panel instead of a free join. No code change is expected.
notes: Filed 2026-10-20 at Daniel's request ("Put June's work in the backlog"). Open and blocked on June An's answers, not on code. Not parked: parking needs a ruling ADR (HYG-161).

verify.evidence: OPEN. Closes when the @frequency owner profile has a Stripe Connect account that can take charges and a paid tier on a Group Space opens checkout instead of a free join.
